page_title: RAY 1-1 LEV | Rayo Vallecano v Levante 16/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Referee Cesar Soto Grado signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Rayo Vallecano players have a reason to celebrate!
90+6' The Rayo Vallecano players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
90+4' 1 - 1 Goal! Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:1.
90+4' Manu Sanchez (Levante) sees a yellow card from Cesar Soto Grado after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+1' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Rayo Vallecano work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

90' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Mathew Ryan pulls off an easy save. Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.
88' Matias Moreno (Levante) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
87' Levante fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
85' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) but poses no threat.
84' Luis Castro has decided to substitute Carlos Espi and he is replaced by Karl Etta Eyong (Levante).
80' Mathew Ryan (Levante) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ivan Balliu leaves the pitch and Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
74' A corner kick by Levante is thwarted by the well prepared Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano).
74' Substitution. Kervin Arriaga (Levante) has come on for Iker Losada.
74' Luis Castro has decided to make a change. Ugo Raghouber (Levante) replaces Ivan Romero.
74' Substitution. Jose Morales (Levante) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Victor Garcia walks off.

73' Victor Garcia (Levante) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball would have probably ended inside the right post, if Augusto Batalla hadn't made a superb save. The ball goes out of play. Levante are awarded a corner kick.
70' Victor Garcia (Levante) unleashes a shot, but it just flies over the bar.
69' The attendance for today's match is 10975.
68' Levante take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
66' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Fran Cortes (Levante) for a tough tackle.
65' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Alemao.
65' Oscar Valentin will be replaced by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano).
59' A quickly taken corner by Rayo Vallecano.
59' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
58' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' A substitution has been made. Kareem Tunde is replaced by Fran Cortes (Levante).
53' A second caution from Cesar Soto Grado for Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) means that he has to leave the pitch early today. It's a red card.
50' Levante can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
49' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Levante, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' Half-time substitution. Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) will not participate anymore and Alvaro Garcia is coming on.
46' The game is over for Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano). Ilias Akhomach comes on for the second half.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Levante.
45' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Levante will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

44' Carlos Espi (Levante) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Augusto Batalla shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
43' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
41' 0 - 1 Carlos Espi (Levante) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the right post. Excellent finish.
40' A yellow card for a tackle by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano). Cesar Soto Grado doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
36' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
36' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner kick.
34' Victor Garcia (Levante) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
30' Kareem Tunde (Levante) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Cesar Soto Grado ignores the protests.
29' What a huge chance for Carlos Espi (Levante). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
28' Ivan Romero (Levante) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
22' None of the Levante players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
21' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Levante, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' Today's referee Cesar Soto Grado rightly decides to book Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) for his harsh tackle.
14' Manu Sanchez (Levante) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Augusto Batalla as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
12' Ivan Romero (Levante) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
7' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Kareem Tunde (Levante), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles away of the left post. Poor effort.
6' Iker Losada (Levante) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
3' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
